newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Dyckerhoff sees 19 pct sales gain.
newsitem.headline: German Dyckerhoff sees 19 pct sales gain.

text.p: German construction group Dyckerhoff AG said on Thursday its 1996 sales rose 19 percent to 2.945 billion marks.
It added that its 1996 net profit would lie somewhere between those reported in 1994 and 1995, a level it described as satisfactory.
Dyckerhoff said gross domestic production grew 1.4 percent in 1996, while construction investment in Germany fell 2.7 percent.
Sales of concrete more than doubled during the year to 680 million marks as a result of acquisitions, with this business segment responsible for most of the overall group revenue increase.
Dyckerhoff also announced it had acquired two cement plants from the French group Ciments Francais in the Czech Republic.
